name: Williams NG Springfield Expansion
researcher_notes: Not a match to an existing row: no Springfield expansion row exists in the roster. Qualifies as a new expansion row. A Federal Register notice from 30 October 1995 (FERC docket CP95-700-000) says Williams Natural Gas Company wanted to extend its Springfield loop line with about 28.2 miles of 20-inch pipeline in Newton, Lawrence and Christian Counties, Missouri, finished before 1 November 1996. That is about 45 km of new pipe, above the 25 km minimum. The EIA August 2026 release (sheet Historical Projects 1996-2024, Excel row 23) lists the project as completed, November 1996, 28.2 miles, 20 inch, 23 MMcf/d added, interstate, FERC, CP95-700. Only EIA states completed status and capacity, so those two values rest on one publisher. The other values are backed by both the notice and EIA. Parent name: Williams Gas Pipelines Central became Southern Star Central, which is the existing system row P0253. That succession was not checked against a cited source here, so confirm the parent name before applying. Start and end are county level only: the notice gives counties, not terminal points. Owner spelling is the rules-based style suggestion, not a gazetteer match, so check it against the ownership team list. The FERC order was not located. A Journal Record article from 1996 on the completion loads in the verifier but could not be read here, so it is not cited. No route found.
